title: AIVV User Preferences v5
description: Schema for .aivv/config.json (project) and ~/.aivv/config.json (user) — v5 contract. Extends v4 with the severity-model selection key (severity_model). Strict additionalProperties:false. v6+ readers bypass-and-warn per established forward-compat strategy.

post_review_html_viewer.description: When true, /aivv renders a static HTML report after durable review/fix state is available. Recommended default for readability; first interactive setup asks before persisting the preference. Browser-open failures never fail review/fix workflows. Pair with post_review_html_open_mode to control link-only vs auto-open behavior.

post_review_html_open_mode.description: Controls what happens after a post-review HTML report is generated. link: show a clear Open report link/path without changing browser focus (recommended). open: also best-effort open the report, preferring a Codex in-app browser local-served URL when available and falling back to the OS opener.

lens_detection_mode.description: Smart lens detection (dev.154). ask=prompt for non-obvious ceiling additions (floor always auto-applies); smart=auto-apply ceiling; off=legacy detect-and-report. See 2026-05-29-smart-lens-detection.

severity_model.description: Selects the severity-derivation model. legacy_4pass: the current 4-pass blast-radius→tone→source-class→improvement inference (the shipped default). impact_likelihood: the forthcoming impact×likelihood model, under active rollout. Optional; absent ⇒ legacy_4pass.

multi_model_enabled.description: Feature gate for multi-model dispatch. When false (default), /aivv behavior is identical to v0.1.

model_policy.description: Global model selection policy. aivv-recommended: use model-catalog.json defaults (stable, updated per AIVV release). family-latest: query provider /v1/models at session start, pick newest in family (accepts ~500ms startup). pinned: use reviewer_primary/secondary/fast as exact model IDs.

reviewer_primary.description: Override for reviewer.primary slot. null = use model-catalog.json aivv_recommended. Set to an exact model ID string when model_policy=pinned.

reviewer_secondary.description: Override for reviewer.secondary slot. null (default) = secondary reviewer inactive. Non-null string = explicit model ID override.

reviewer_fast.description: Override for reviewer.fast slot. null (default) = fast reviewer inactive. Non-null string = explicit model ID override.

dispatch_strategy.description: How reviewer slots are activated. single: reviewer.primary only. parallel: all enabled slots. cascade: fast first, escalate to primary on low-findings+complex-diff. auto: rule-based routing (lens+security-pattern+size).

synthesis_enabled.description: When true, run the blind synthesis pass (Stage 6) to merge findings from multiple reviewers into a single attributed description.

parallel_quorum.description: Minimum fraction of dispatched reviewers that must respond before synthesis proceeds. floor(N * parallel_quorum) reviewers required.

reviewer_timeout_seconds.description: Per-reviewer hard timeout in seconds. AbortController cancels the fetch after this duration.

routing_rules.description: User override routing rules (max 4). Each rule is a structured object with when + strategy/slots. Rules evaluated in order; first match wins.

auth_mode.description: Global auth resolution mode. auto (default): try CLI OAuth first (Google agy or legacy gemini / codex auth), then env var API key — no API key required by default. api_key: skip CLI path, require env var API key.

auth_mode_anthropic.description: Per-provider auth override for Anthropic. null = inherit global auth_mode. auto: claude CLI subprocess (uses existing OAuth session) → ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. cli: claude CLI subprocess only. api_key: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY only.

auth_mode_gemini.description: Per-provider auth override for Gemini. null = inherit global auth_mode. auto: Google CLI subprocesses (agy, then legacy gemini) → api_key. cli: Google CLI subprocesses only. api_key: GEMINI_API_KEY env var only.

auth_mode_openai.description: Per-provider auth override for OpenAI/Codex. null = inherit global auth_mode. auto: cli → api_key. cli: codex CLI subprocess only (requires codex auth). api_key: OPENAI_API_KEY env var only. (~/.codex/config.json apiKey fallback is documented in .aivv/platform-adapters/openai.md as a Cycle 2 design — not yet shipped as of dev.124.)

reviewer_provider_priority.description: Priority order for selecting providers in Case D multi-model dispatch. When the effective reviewer count N (--reviewers=N or default_reviewers) is less than the number of available providers, the orchestrator selects the first N providers from this list that are also in providers_available. Reorder to change which providers fire by default; omit a provider entirely to disable it even when available.

multi_model_fallback_strategy.description: What to do when a provider fails (quota, timeout, auth). ask (default): prompt the user with 4 choices (skip / replicate-with-default-provider / always-skip / always-replicate) — the last two persist the choice by rewriting this key to 'none' or 'subagents' respectively. subagents: dispatch one independent reviewer using reviewer_provider_priority[0] (default: anthropic) per failed provider to maintain reviewer count — same behavior as --reviewers=N for the failed slots. none: proceed with only the successful providers' findings.

multi_model_disclosure_shown.description: Suppresses the data egress disclosure banner after first showing. Set to true manually or via the one-time banner prompt.

workspace_drift_policy.description: Behavior when workspace SHA drift is detected during reviewer dispatch. 'void' = original behavior (void the review immediately). 'warn' = continue with a warning banner. 'investigate' = orchestrator checks whether drifted files are in session scope AND whether any reviewer declared write tools; voids only when both checks indicate out-of-scope external write. Default 'investigate' reduces false-void noise from concurrent orchestrator state writes.

max_challenges_per_invocation.description: Token-budget circuit-breaker for Step 4.5 CHALLENGE. When N batches have been challenged in a single /aivv-fix invocation, remaining batches proceed to Step 5 without challenge.

shared_interface_patterns.description: Regex patterns for detecting shared interfaces in fix_proposal.files_to_modify. Paths matching any pattern trigger the 'touches_shared_interface' fix_confidence demotion predicate in Step 4.

enable_step_57_execution.description: When true, Step 5.7 ORCHESTRATOR EXECUTION runs new build-script / ci-gate / verification-method scripts post-EXECUTE and captures execution evidence for the verifier. Default false for the first 3 dogfood cycles per default-off ship discipline.
